rationale: The Logic section describes operations common to both versions: initial and final buffer-size checks, copying the serialized entry into a temporary structure, handling flag-dependent and compressed paths, allocating a temporary path when needed, and duplicating the entry to the output. Although the fixed version additionally rejects an entry_size of zero and uses a separate out_size parameter/status return convention, the statement that it “ensures that the entry is valid” is too general to unambiguously describe that fixed-only check. It does not specify the zero-size condition or another concrete mitigation.
